name: Taskhold
description: A hosted task list you share with your coding agents. Agents pick up the next task, split it into steps, report progress on a live board and block with a question when they need you; every change is marked human or agent.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Taskhold in your browser (OAuth). The server supports Dynamic Client Registration, so no client ID or API key is needed. Paid: $12/month with a 7-day trial.
